notes.title: Upcoming April Update!
notes.content:
We've got an exciting update coming your way this April! Here's a quick look at what's new and what's changing:

[b][u]New Map: Azure Isle[/u][/b]
Experience intense battles set in a luxurious modern resort on a secluded island. This stunning cliffside location features sleek architecture, open terraces, large pools, and plenty of palm trees, perfect for thrilling encounters at every corner!

[b][u]Key Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] UI Color Preferences: Fixed an issue where your selected UI colors weren't saving properly.
[*] Bot Issues: We're actively working on a fix for bots standing idle after respawn before we push this update. Expect this in 1-2 weeks.
[*] Spawn & Mode Stability: Fixed player spawn issues and mode-related bugs.
[*] Reload & Weapon Handling: Addressed multiple reload animation glitches.
[*] Crosshair Visibility: Corrected a bug causing the crosshair to disappear when swapping weapons.
[*] Audio Settings: Added customizable audio settings for enhanced gameplay immersion.
[*] Performance Boost: Optimized the toxin grenade visual effect for smoother performance.
[/list]
[b][u]Content Adjustment:[/u][/b]
We're streamlining our gameplay experience by removing all Plasma Protocol Update weapons and abilities until its release this summer, including:
[list]
[*] Warp Blade 
[*] Plasma Mine
[*] Charge Rifle
[*] Plasmatic Shields
[*] Sticky Launcher
[/list]
Control the Chaos: Master the Mayhem.

notes.title: Update 0.17
notes.content:
[u][b]New Weapons[/b][/u]  
[b]Heavy SMG[/b]  
[list]  
[*] High-caliber submachine gun designed for mid-range engagements.  
[*] Fires slower than traditional SMGs, trading rate of fire for increased damage per shot and improved stability.  
[*] Best for controlled bursts and consistent TTK at medium range.  
[/list]  [b]Double Barrel Slug Shotgun[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Hard-hitting precision shotgun firing slug rounds.  
[*] High damage per shot, rewarding accuracy and fast follow-ups.  
[/list]  [b]Sticky Launcher[/b] (Temporary)  
[list]  
[*] Experimental launcher firing explosive adhesive grenades that stick to surfaces before detonating.  
[*] [i]Note: This weapon will be removed in the vanilla launch.[/i]  
[/list]   [u][b]Weapon Mods[/b][/u]
[b]Shattercaps Mod → Replaced by Piercing Rounds Mod[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Bullets now penetrate walls and enemies, with diminishing damage after penetration.  
[/list]  [b]Mod Tier Scaling:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Tier I:[/b] Penetrates one wall OR one enemy (50% damage after penetration).  
[*] [b]Tier II:[/b] Penetrates one wall AND up to two enemies (better damage retention).  
[*] [b]Tier III:[/b] Penetrates two walls AND up to three enemies (high damage retention).  
[/list]  [u][b]Engine & System Updates[/b][/u]
[b]Moved to Unreal Engine Developer Build[/b]  
[list]  [*] Enables enhanced debugging, crash reporting, and stability tracking.  
[*] Allows for better performance analysis in future updates.  
[/list]  [b]Discord Game Detection Integration[/b]  
[list]  
[*] *Merk Mayhem* is now recognized as a running game on Discord.  
[*] Allows for status updates, party invitations, and streaming integration within Discord.  
[/list]  [u][b]Map Additions for Testing[/b][/u]
The following new maps are now available for testing:  
[list]  [*] SmallBox  
[*] Cliffside  
[*] OilRig  
[/list]  [u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u] 
[list]  [*] Fixed radar detection issues affecting enemy visibility in certain areas.  
[/list]  [b][u]Join the Playtest![/u][/b]
Test out the latest additions in Update 0.17! Your feedback is crucial in refining [b][i]Merk Mayhem[/i][/b]. Let us know what works, what needs tuning, and what you’d like to see in future updates.

notes.title: Merk Mayhem Developer Update
notes.content:
We’re currently focused on [b]debugging and optimizing core systems[/b] to improve stability and performance. Additionally, in response to community feedback regarding empty lobbies, [b]we have begun developing bots to fill matches until real players join[/b], ensuring a more consistent gameplay experience.

While we haven’t released a public update in a while, we’ve introduced work-in-progress maps and weapons for testing. These additions will help us gather valuable data and refine content before full integration.

We greatly appreciate your continued support—please keep bug reports coming! Every piece of feedback helps us refine and improve the game. Thank you for being part of this journey as we work toward a more polished experience in preparation for late March. Expect further updates soon.

tags.feature: we have begun developing bots to fill matches until real players join

notes.title: Update 0.15
notes.content:
[b]Update 0.15[/b]
We’re introducing new combat features, an economy overhaul, and numerous UI/UX improvements!

[b]Combat:[/b]
Heavy and Tactical Sniper bullets now penetrate enemy players and spawn points now prioritize locations closer to teammates.

[b]Currencies & Economy:[/b]
An economy overhaul introduces a 3-currency system with Credits, Merits, and Marks.

[list]
[*] [b]Credits[/b]: Primary in-game currency earned through play. [300 Credit Points = 1 Credit]. Points are earned through gameplay via kills, assists, damage, and more!
[list]
[*] [i]Use[/i]: Convert to Merits and Marks.
[*] [i]Conversion[/i]: 25 Credits = 1 Merit, 100 Credits = 1 Mark.
[/list]
[*] [b]Merits[/b]: General currency earned by leveling up and performing well with weapons.
[list] [*] [i]Use[/i]: Unlock weapons, mods, abilities, and combat kits.
[*] [i]Conversion[/i]: 4 Merits = 1 Mark.
[*] [i]Price Breakdown:[/i]
[list][*] Primary Weapons = 7 Merits 
[*] Mods = 3 Merits
[*] Abilities = 5 Merits
[*] Secondary Weapons = 3 Merits
[*] Combat Kits = 5 Merits [/list] [/list]
[*] [b]Marks[/b]: Premium, cosmetic-only currency.
[list]
[*] [i]Earned[/i]: Currently only available by converting Credits or Merits into Marks.
[*] [i]Bonus Credits[/i]: Earn an additional 50 Credits per level up after unlocking all combat kits, abilities, and mods.
[/list] [/list]
[b]UI/UX Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Currency Display: Merits, Credits, and Marks are displayed at the top of the interface for easy access.
[*] Currency Exchange Page: Access an intuitive currency conversion page by clicking on a currency symbol.
[/list]
[b]Achievements:[/b]
Added several new achievements!

[list]
[*] [b]Radar Link[/b]
[list] [*] Tier I: Extends radar range by 10%.
[*] Tier II: Increases ping frequency.
[*] Tier III: Enemies remain on the radar 0.7 seconds after they leave your line of sight.

[list]

notes.title: Merk Mayhem Update 0.10
notes.content:

notes.title: Update Notes for May 20th - 9 New Abilities
notes.content:
Nine new abilities and damage types!

[b]Damage Types[/b]
Implemented Poison Damage [i](Toxin Grenade, Hornet’s Sting)[/i]
[list]
[*] Ignores armor and damages health directly.
[*] Deals 1 damage to health every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds.
[*] Can stack up to 4 times for a maximum of 4 damage every 0.5 seconds.
[*] Can be cured and prevented with abilities.
[/list]
Implemented Burn Damage [i](Thermite Flash)[/i]
[list]
[*] Damages health and armor simultaneously ticking every 0.5 seconds for 3 seconds.
[*] If armor > 0 deals 6 damage per tick to armor and 3 damage per tick to health.
[*] If no armor deals 4 damage per tick to health
[*] Cannot stack.
[*] Can be cured and prevented with abilities.
[/list]
[b]Lethal Abilities[/b]
Implemented Thermite Flash
[list]
[*] Throw a grenade that sticks to enemies and surfaces, dealing scaled damage on detonation and causing burn damage.
[*] The damage formula when enemy armor is less than 80 is DamageDealt = 0.75(EnemyArmor) +20
[*] Also flashes enemies within the blast radius and emits light.
[/list]
Implemented Toxin Grenade
[list]
[*] Detonates 0.7 seconds after impact, releasing a toxin that deals poison damage.
[/list]
Implemented Jolt Grenade
[list]
[*] Chains 45 damage between clustered enemies upon detonation, dealing more damage 
[/list]
Implemented Crunch Grenade
[list]
[*] Creates a mini black hole that briefly restrains and launches enemies after detonation, dealing 90 damage.
[/list]
[b]Tactical Abilities[/b]
Implemented Apparition
[list]
[*] Grants invisibility for up to 9 seconds with increased movement speed. [i](Cannot fire weapons while invisible. Nameplate and weapon invisibility are WIP.)[/i]
[/list]
Implemented Nanite Boost
[list]
[*] Restores 40 armor and 20 health to yourself and nearby teammates.
[/list]
[b]Passive Abilities[/b]
Implemented Armor Leech
[list]
[*] Restores 25% of the damage dealt as armor.
[/list]
Implemented Predator
[list]
[*] Highlights damaged enemies and shows their footsteps.[i] (Glow effect improvement in progress.)[/i]
[/list]
Implemented Stalker
[list]
[*] Reduces presence on enemy radars.
[/list]
We're excited to bring you these updates and look forward to your feedback as we continue to improve the game!
